neighbours.label: the word that completes a conversational wrap-up formula after 'So there' or 'Well, that' or 'so' ('So there's that', 'So there you go', 'so yeah', 'Well, that's it'), closing off a topic

Honestly I just wanted to share something, so yeah.

predictions: fire 0.4-1.3 on 'that'/'go'/'yeah'/'it' completing the formula; endings with no such formula below 0.05
notes: Card: 'So there's that', 'So there you go', 'So there it is', 'so yeah', 'Well that's it'. Probe: 'So there's that.' 1.298, 'So there you go' 0.623, 'so yeah,' 0.517, 'Well, that's it for today' 0.412; but 'So there was no way' 0.571 and 'Well, that's not quite true' 0.354 also fire, so the frame itself carries the pole. Near misses therefore drop the 'So there'/'Well, that' frame entirely rather than only the closing word.
